skills.trigger: When evaluating a patient with dysphonia and risk factors (e.g., alcohol abuse) for suspected tracheal malignancy on axial chest CT.
steps: Inspect the central mediastinum at the level of the trachea for soft tissue abnormalities.
Identify ill-defined soft tissue infiltration or mass effect directly adjacent to or involving the tracheal wall/lumen.
Distinguish this central airway pathology from peripheral pulmonary nodules or infiltrates, which would not typically cause voice changes.
